 South Korean skincare is all the rage these days with tourists flying thousands of miles for their next fix. Re20 is a new treatment made with donated cadaver skin that’s injected into your face. It’s not FDA approved which is raising some concerns about ethics and safety. NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian reports. Nov. 21, 2026
